notes: Curated checks for one-pager-and-slide-outline. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested; score focused revisions on the affected decisions and retained constraints. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please package a defined or approved narrative into a concise one-pager, an assertion-led slide outline, or both from supplied source material.
I need help with leave-behinds, briefing notes, internal memos, and stakeholder updates when the underlying strategy already exists.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable one pager and slide outline and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build cross-functional launch readiness plans and field-ready launch assets for revenue teams.
Please convert product or engineering release notes into concise field updates with customer impact, positioning implications, and action guidance.
Please build and refine value propositions and messaging frameworks for revenue teams.

output_structure_checks.name: one-pager-and-slide-outline-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Delivers only the requested branch or revision, preserves effective wording, and uses assertion headlines where they help. Navigation labels and genuine audience questions need not become assertions.

output_structure_checks.name: one-pager-and-slide-outline-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.

output_structure_checks.name: one-pager-and-slide-outline-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Preserves approved strategy and useful supplied structure, and keeps source or approval notes separate from audience-facing copy.

output_structure_checks.name: one-pager-and-slide-outline-external-action-approval
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps drafting separate from sending, publishing or changing shared records. Requires explicit approval for the relevant audience and external changes.
